subject.title: fix(agents): emit diagnostic when sessions_yield parks without continuation evidence

question: Should the diagnostic be suppressed by broad terminal evidence such as any active descendant or successful cron add, or only by visible delivery and continuation explicitly registered to wake this yielded turn?
rationale: Current runtime state cannot prove that an arbitrary active descendant is fresh or relevant to the yielded turn, and the linked incident specifically depends on that distinction; choosing the permanent yield contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Require registered wake evidence
options.body: Suppress the warning only for visible delivery or continuation demonstrably bound to resume this yielded turn, rather than any active descendant or generic cron addition.

options.title: Accept broad terminal evidence
options.body: Keep the current helper semantics and intentionally treat any active descendant, cron add, approval prompt, delivery, spawn, or async tool as sufficient to avoid the warning.

recommendation.title: Require registered wake evidence
recommendation.body: Suppress the warning only for visible delivery or continuation demonstrably bound to resume this yielded turn, rather than any active descendant or generic cron addition.

likelyOwner.reason: The original sessions_yield feature and spawn-then-yield contract appear to date to this person's merged implementation.
